Name: PlayMusic
Author: clowngunda
Description:
[size=3]In [i]Stardew Valley[/i], use the game's 25 built-in flute sounds to perform anywhere.
Press the Z key to enter performance mode. In this mode, other key inputs will be disabled. Press the Z key or Esc key to exit performance mode and return to normal operations.
The default key bindings for the scale are as follows:
The range covers the Q–] keys and the A–Enter keys (standard keyboard layout).
For smoother transitions, the C3–B3 range is mapped to the Q–U keys, while subsequent keys represent semitones interspersed within the previous range (e.g., semitones).
Key bindings can be customized via the GenericModConfigMenu interface.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

在《星露谷物语》使用游戏内置的 25 种长笛音色进行演奏：
[list]

[*]按​​Z键​​进入演奏模式，该模式下其他按键操作将被取消
[*]按​​Z键​​或​​Esc键​​可退出演奏模式并恢复正常操作
[/list]默认快捷键位置绑定：
[list]
[*]音阶范围覆盖​​Q–]​​键和​​A–Enter​​键（标准键盘布局）

[*]后续键盘以半音形式交错分布（例如U键后的音阶将通过J、I、O等键盘时序）
[/list]按键位支持通过通用模组配置菜单（GenericModConfigMenu）​​界面进行自定义修改。
